project: The First Perception - Living World RPG Engine
version_notes: v0.8 schema pack — Sec L bundle promotion (~46 anchors across Bundles A-H) + 8 cluster anchors (Cluster B BES/FS + Cluster C CMB) + 14 foundation $defs surfaced by Phase 24a (weather_pattern, exit_block, poi_block, lock_requirement_block, skill_check_block, secret_block, dialogue_state_block, goal_block, action_economy_block, trigger_block, effect_block, faction_plan_block, focus_block, npc_closing_condition_entry). Phase 24a Player-runtime additions documented as REQUIRED. Engine-types.ts duplicate-shape absorption per Option A (Session 5 cutover). Stats dual-block storage per Khoja Option C (custom_stats_block + derived_stats_block both REQUIRED on PlayerSchema). Focus per Khoja Option B (focus_block new $def). Sources: V08_PROMOTION_SCOPE.md (Session 3.5 locked output), repo_mirror/phase_24a/*, bundle_specs/*.md.
manifesto_guardrails: Greywake is the seed, not the soil
Authority has a price (universal canon-cost layer on leveled spellcasting)

0.8.0.summary: v0.8 schema pack — Sec L bundle promotion + foundation $defs from Phase 24a runtime reconciliation. Heavy normalization target per ARD-016. Generator pipeline per ARD-009. Persistence target: Supabase Postgres.
0.8.0.engine_types_absorption_strategy: Option A (Session 5 cutover) — engine-types.ts duplicates absorbed into schema entities
0.8.0.stats_system: Option C dual blocks (custom_stats_block + derived_stats_block both REQUIRED on PlayerSchema)
0.8.0.focus_block: Option B (focus_block new $def, mirrors HpBlock pattern)

changelog.0.4.1: Patch — adds canon_progression_entry.threshold_spent_until_day (closes R-86 from M2 paper prototype). Additive only.
changelog.0.4: 25 additives across Bundle A + Bundle C; 5 new top-level schemas. Closes v0.4 R-60 redux. Manifesto regression check clean.
changelog.0.3: Initial formalization of v0.2 + v0.3 additive fields. Closed R-60.
changelog.0.2: (unreleased) workflow atlas + ERD + contradiction ledger entry shapes
changelog.0.1: Initial schema pack: campaign, player, event, faction, npc, rumor, belief, consequence, state_diff

0.5.0.summary: Full-sweep v0.5 additive: 80 candidates applied (19 SC/R-73, 44 FDR, 17 P).
0.5.0.regression_check: v0.4.1 records remain valid — all additions are optional fields or new schemas.

0.6.0.summary: Catalog port: discriminator-typed item subtypes, v2-canonical recipe shape, new litany/marginalia/imposed_spell schemas, field gap closures.
breaking_changes: recipe.ingredients -> materials; output_item_id -> produces_item_id; station_required -> primary_station_id. v1 normalized at port.

0.7.0.summary: Opex throttle layer: +3 schemas (opex_state, opex_event, model_tier_policy) for daily-cap counter, per-call ledger, and tiered-fallback routing policy.

weather_pattern.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Region weather variability source-of-truth. No v0.7 equivalent; runtime Region.weatherPatterns had no schema home.

type.description: Weather kind: sun, fog, storm, salt-rain, low-tide, high-tide, etc.

exit_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — LocationNode.exits structured shape. Reconciles with v0.7 travel_route $def (inverse direction); v0.8 keeps both; engine adapter translates at scene-load boundary.

poi_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — LocationNode.pointsOfInterest structured shape. Sub-location investigation surface.

lock_requirement_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Exit.locked structured shape. Either a key-item, a skill check, or both gate the exit.

key_item_id.description: FK → item.item_id; null if no key required.

skill_check_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Generic skill check shape. Uses CoreStat per Khoja Option C dual-stats decision (engine narrative system reads custom_stats; SRD layers read derived_stats via translation rule).

stat.description: 9-CoreStat Tide-Stained system. v0.8 stat system per Khoja Option C.

dc.description: Difficulty class threshold the d20 roll + stat modifier must meet or exceed.

secret_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — NPC.secrets[] structured shape. Per-secret reveal mechanics. v0.8 promotes from runtime Secret type.

topic_id.description: Topic category — used by dialogue_state_block + Bundle G information shaping_operator.

difficulty.description: DC required to extract the secret. Paired with skill_check_block when an explicit check is performed.

dialogue_state_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — NPC.dialogueState structured replacement for opaque Record<string, unknown>. Pairs with Bundle F prompt_skeleton + Bundle G knowledge_tri_layer.says policy.

active_topic_id.description: Currently-open dialogue topic; null if NPC is idle.

exhausted.description: Topic has been fully explored; no further dialogue available.

stance_drift.description: Cumulative dialogue-driven stance shift; engine uses to adjust faction trust.

transient_flags.description: Per-turn dialogue flags (e.g. {threatened: true, charmed: false}). Cleared on dialogue exit.

goal_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured goal shape replacing NPC.wants string + Faction.goals opaque arrays. Pairs with Bundle A want_model (NPC scale) + Bundle C faction_ledger (faction scale).

target_id.description: Optional FK to the target entity (npc_id / faction_id / item_id / location_id / belief_id).

abandoned_reason.description: Populated when goal is dropped without being achieved.

action_economy_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Per-turn action budget. Promoted from runtime ActionEconomy (Phase 24a Player.actionEconomy).

reaction.description: Reaction available until next turn start.

trigger_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured predicate replacing runtime Consequence.trigger. Pairs with schema's existing consequence.trigger_type + trigger_value.

kind.description: Trigger taxonomy. Matches v0.7 consequence.trigger_type enum + adds narrative_event.

value.description: Trigger-specific value (e.g. day number for time, condition_id for condition, threshold spec for threshold).

predicate.description: Optional engine-evaluated predicate for complex triggers.

armed_at.description: Timestamp / world_time when the trigger became active.

effect_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured effect shape for what happens when a consequence/condition fires. Replaces runtime ConditionEffect + Effect.

kind.description: Effect taxonomy. Matches the visible categories the runtime emits.

target.description: FK to the entity affected (player / npc_id / faction_id / region_id / item_id).

magnitude.description: Signed magnitude where applicable (e.g. stat_modifier=+2; hp_delta=-3).

duration_turns.description: How long the effect lasts. null = permanent until removed; 0 = instantaneous.

narrative_phrase.description: Optional engine-narration phrase for tale entries.

faction_plan_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 / 24a-surfaced — Structured faction plan replacing opaque envelope. Pairs with Bundle C faction_tick_resolution.

current_step.description: Index into plan_steps[] of the step the faction is currently executing.

cadence.description: Tick cadence (same enum as ambition_tick.cadence per Bundle A).

target_entity_id.description: Optional FK to the entity this step acts on.

result_band.description: Outcome band; null until step resolves.

last_tick_at.description: Timestamp / world_time of last cadence tick.

focus_block.description: Phase 24b §4.1 — NEW $def per Khoja Option B ratification (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md). Mirrors HpBlock structure. Required on PlayerSchema in v0.8. Focus is mechanically distinct from meters (meters = world-state perceptions; focus = character resource pool).

recovery_rate.description: Per-rest recovery; null = none. Engine reads at long-rest.

source_kind.description: Narrative context for the focus source.

npc_closing_condition_entry.description: Phase 24b §4.1 — Sub-$def used by Bundle A L.I-SC-03 closing_conditions field. Each NPC carries an array of ≥2 entries; ≥1 must be player_reachable=true (Death's binding rule).

kind.description: Closing-state taxonomy. Native Postgres ENUM at DDL emission time.

consequence_summary.description: Engine annotation for what the world looks like after this closure fires.

residue_drive.description: Populated on passover_state only — becomes new active drive after passover fires.

transfer_target_npc_id.description: Populated on transfer_state only — FK to receiving NPC.

spell_cost_layer.description: R-51 universal canon-cost on leveled spellcasting. Cantrips remain free.

scarred_until_day.description: v0.4 Bundle A: when sworn slot is broken or fulfilled, may scar; cannot accept new attunement until this in-world day.

threshold_spent_until_day.description: v0.4.1 (R-86): in-world day until which a spent end-condition threshold cannot retrigger. Set when player refuses apotheosis (X.12), self-unmaking (X.13), or withdrawal (X.14). null means threshold is not in spent state. State Manager owns set; clears automatically when current_time.day exceeds this value.

kind.description: R-99-C: constrained vocabulary; Greywake-native frame locked

reversibility_event_id.description: R-101-C: canon-event that could reverse, if reversible

adaptagen_active.description: R-102-C: bottled mutagenic relics currently active

world_pulse_ticker_item.x_description: R-113-D: derived from events; transient session state for the Live Ticker UI.

party_state.description: R-132-P: top-level party tracking. 4-max party (1 player + up to 3 companions).

former_party_members.description: R-148-P: persistent post-departure state for companions who left the party.

session_log.description: R-97-B: ordered session_ids that have committed against this campaign. Multi-session replay support.

tab_grouping_1366.description: R-62 closure: per-tab collapse preferences at 1366×768

ui_preference_state.description: R-117-D: persistent UI prefs. Closes R-62.

world_pulse_recurring_events.description: R-127-F (speculative): scheduled events that fire on a cadence (e.g., weekly salt vigil) outside the agent loop.

form_of_ending_narration.description: R-88-A: Narrator-generated terminal text (postcard-shaped). Per Narrator Form-of-Ending prompt. Persisted for Death/Legacy screen rendering.

body_modifications_block.description: Deferred bundle (mad-sci track). Schema slot pre-wired per v0.4 Bundle A; awaiting design pass.

locations_known.description: R-107-C: per-location knowledge map (deferred bundle: exploration_system)

ai_cosmetic_slot.description: AI-generated cosmetic image path (set at character creation)

portrait_state.description: R-111-D: Portrait System state per FDR Part 1.5 spec.

knowledge_posture_history.description: R-115-D: posture switches over time; affects achievement eligibility per v0.1 Ch V.

last_main_scene_focus_at.description: R-119-E: per Glance Bar mechanism (FDR Part 2.3)

session_state.description: Transient session state on player; cleared on session boundary.

scrip_speculation_history.description: R-124-E: speculative-profit tracking for R-65 (scrip speculation cap at 25% gain).

dream_state.description: R-128-F (speculative): a separate substrate where dream-region content could play. v0.3 framing.

legacy_inherited_substrate_weight.description: R-131-F (speculative): per-substrate weight inherited from prior characters. Per X.12/X.16 legacy seeding; multi-character campaign play.

per_actor.description: R-143-P: per-actor canon credit (companion_id or player_id → credit object). Replaces v0.4 player-only.

party_member_witnesses.description: R-147-P: companion_ids that witnessed this event. Multi-witness mechanics — Bell Court testimony, Drowned Church doctrinal weighting.

agent_provenance.description: R-95-B: map of event-field-path → agent_name that produced it. Debug aid + replay determinism.

combat_state.description: R-146-P: combat state inside event. No separate combat entity in v0.5 (deferred bundle).

diegetic_elements.description: R-114-D: per-scene catalog of clickable diegetic UI elements with their state. Scoped to events because event has scene context.

public_summary_for_ticker.description: R-118-D: optional ticker-ready summary populated by Narrator. Null when event is not surfaceable.

scene_id.description: R-122-E: groups events by scene for easier filtering. Replaces implicit grouping.

faction_obligation_state_per_companion.description: R-145-P: faction-mediated terms per-companion. Keyed by companion_id.

scheduled_actions.description: R-123-E: faction plans with scheduled execution day. Per Notice Ladder Tracker timing R-79.

tracker_state.description: R-98-B: per-NPC tracker fields when operating as a Notice-Ladder tracker. Per R-82 Notice Ladder.

recruitable_via_bond.description: R-139-P: NPC can be recruited via bond-path (organic-trust-build over multiple scenes).

recruitable_via_canon_event.description: R-140-P: NPC becomes recruitable on this canon-event-kind firing. event_kind reference or null.

behavior_tree_state.description: R-108-C (deferred): behavior tree state for NPCs. Awaiting v0.5 NPC behavior tree design pass.

grudge_ledger.description: R-110-C (deferred): persistent grudges with weight + source_event_id. NPC memory beyond current_plan.

witness_history.description: R-121-E: NPC's witness history. NPC Evaluator uses this for response generation.

replay_seed.description: R-92-B: RNG seed that produced this state_diff. Required for tests/replay_determinism.py.

validator_chain_pass_detailed.description: R-94-B: per-stage validator result with reason on failure. Expansion of v0.4 boolean validator_chain_pass.

dependency_event_ids.description: R-96-B: event_ids this diff depends on having committed first. Required for replay ordering.

surfacing_state.description: R-126-E: contradiction surfacing trigger. R-81 closure.

surface_after_day.description: R-126-E: day at which contradiction should surface to player. Null = never auto-surface.

faith_meter_negative_value_ui_treatment.description: R-125-E: how negative faith values render in UI. R-83 closure.

tags.description: Tooling/content tags (slice_eligible, imposed_eligible, etc.). Replaces semantic misuse of domain_aligned for tagging.

creates_canon_event_on_cast.description: Explicit flag: this spell creates a canon event when cast. Helps State Manager event-emission logic vs. inferring from cost_layer.

subschool.description: Subschool within parent school. 14 subschools used in v0.4.3 originals.

wild_twist.description: One-line distinctive mechanical twist of an original spell. Surfaced in spell-picker UI for discoverability.

effects_on_attune_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_attune (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_attune field retained for backward compat.

effects_on_equip_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_equip (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_equip field retained for backward compat.

effects_on_use_structured.description: SC-16: structured replacement for effects_on_use (string[]). Tooling-parseable. Original effects_on_use field retained for backward compat.

soul_kind.description: R-73: soul_kind gating — what kind of soul-substrate this item carries. Bound at craft-commit per Bundle A.

witness_payload.description: Witness-bearing payload on items. R-73 (Bundle A) + SC-07.

adaptagen_kind.description: R-103-C (deferred mad-sci): item is an adaptagen of this kind. Null for non-adaptagen items.

evolution_ledger.description: R-129-F (speculative): items that change over time without crafting. The rust pattern on a long-held weapon. World-remembers extension.

station_alternative_routes.description: R-120-E: M2 finding R-85. If primary station inaccessible, list of fallbacks with consequences.

weather_state.description: R-130-F (speculative): weather as world-state. Currently narrated, not modeled.

template_grammar_version.description: Version flag indicating creates_item_id_template fields parse against the v0.5 grammar: variables marked as ${var_name}, substitutions resolved by State Manager at canon-event.

provenance_chain.description: SC-07: ordered history of past holders/uses, for items that carry deep memory.

tier.description: Material tier; T1<=50cp, T2=51-500, T3=501-5000, T4>5000. Was previously inferred from value_cp_per_unit bands.

slice_eligible.description: Material is approved for M8 Greywake slice ship. Replaces memory_tag interim flag.

is_intermediate.description: Material is a craft-intermediate, not a primary harvestable resource. E.g., vial_of_practiced_name_water.

sourcing_geography.description: Where this material is sourced: biome / region kind / institution control. E.g., ['salt_marsh', 'coastal', 'drowned_church_grounds'].

decay_states.description: Decay rules — material crumbles or transforms outside given context. E.g., salt-rime outside region_greywake.

craft_tracks_eligible.description: Explicit list of craft tracks that may use this material.

acquisition_method.description: How this material becomes obtainable. Some (e.g., mat_listening_child_pebble) cannot be purchased.

creature_material.x_load_bearing: 19 v0.4.2 baseline records depend on this gap closing

witness_payload.description: Some creature materials carry witness (e.g., a Drowned Church saint's bone)

dc_modifier.description: DC adjustment when alternative is used (typically positive)

yield_modifier.description: Multiplier on yield when alternative used

autonomous_drivers.description: R-136-P: 8-driver layer governing autonomous behavior between scenes

witnessed_event_ids.description: R-142-P: events this companion has witnessed (for witness-bearing mechanics)

canon_progression_credit.description: R-143-P: companions accumulate their own canon-progression credit; can experience X.12-X.16 endings

stats_block.description: Full stat block; same shape as player.stats_block

rng_seed.description: Deterministic seed for this session's RNG stream

rng_stream_position.description: Number of RNG draws consumed so far

completion_offer.description: What is offered to the player at quest completion (often the companion joining)

kind_specific_fields.description: Variant payload per kind; shape determined by kind value (deferred design pass)

triggered_by.description: What state condition (e.g., faith>=5_to_unnamed, condition_id=bonded_to_marrow_saint) triggers this overlay

tags.description: Tooling/content tags (slice_eligible, imposed_eligible, etc.). Replaces semantic misuse of domain_aligned for tagging.

creates_canon_event_on_cast.description: Explicit flag: this spell creates a canon event when cast. Helps State Manager event-emission logic vs. inferring from cost_layer.

subschool.description: Subschool within parent school. 14 subschools used in v0.4.3 originals.

wild_twist.description: One-line distinctive mechanical twist of an original spell. Surfaced in spell-picker UI for discoverability.

utc_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; primary key. Lazy reset on first read of a new date.

daily_spend_usd.description: Running total spent today across all agents and models, in USD.

daily_cap_usd.description: Configured ceiling for this date. When daily_spend_usd >= daily_cap_usd, premium tier is unavailable.

session_budgets.description: Per-session token budget tracking (in-memory mirror of DB rows for fast cap checks).

agent_tiers.description: Maps agent_id to default tier under normal conditions.

fallback_chains.description: Maps tier to ordered list of model_ids. Tried in order; first success wins.

cap_buffer_pct.description: Buffer on daily cap to absorb concurrent-Lambda race condition. e.g., 0.1 = stop at 90% of cap.
